import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

command = [\"node\", \"--test\", \"--test-name-pattern=规则遗漏、摘要漂移、批准不匹配和离线资源丢失阻断导出\", \"scripts/verify-strategic-handoff-package-scenarios\"]
env = os.environ.copy()
env[\"TMPDIR\"] = str(Path.cwd())
env[\"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE\"] = \"1\"
with Path(\"cross-repo.log\").open(\"wb\") as log:
    completed = subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
print(f\"exit_code={completed.returncode}\")
print(Path(\"cross-repo.log\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\"), end=\"\")
PY"

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

log = Path(\"cross-repo.log\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
match = re.search(r\""'^ℹ tests ('"\\d+)\\s*"'$", log, re.MULTILINE)
if match is None:
    raise RuntimeError("原始日志中未找到实际测试数量")
result = {
    "command": ["node", "--test", "--test-name-pattern=规则遗漏、摘要漂移、批准不匹配和离线资源丢失阻断导出", "scripts/verify-strategic-handoff-package-scenarios"],
    "exit_code": 0,
    "actual_test_count": int(match.group(1)),
    "limitations": [
        "仅运行指定的既有隔离测试场景；Node 报告 1 个测试通过，场景内的多个拒绝断言不分别计为测试。",
        "测试数据与批准记录仅为 test-data-only，不构成真实项目批准，也不证明真实跨仓交付、构建或发布成功。",
        "TMPDIR 指向当前 fixture，临时测试文件由既有场景清理；未访问网络、安装依赖或执行真实外部交付。"
    ]
}
Path("cross-repo-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "'"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")
assert json.loads(Path(\"cross-repo-result.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) == result
print(Path(\"cross-repo-result.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"), end=\"\")
PY"
